Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research focused on national-scale land-use and land-cover (LULC) prediction in Japan. It explicitly develops and validates spatially explicit LULC scenarios at 500 m resolution across the entire country using the PANCES framework. The study implements multiple future scenarios (NC, ND, PC, PD, and BaU) and includes quantitative comparison via intensity analysis and Figure of Merit components (hits, misses, false alarms). It reports mapped LULC projections for 10 categories derived from vegetation inventory data and evaluates model accuracy using established spatial metrics. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy assessment, and mapped outputs. No exclusion criteria apply—the study is not global, regional, species-focused, economic-only, methodological without application, qualitative, or limited to a single BAU scenario.)
